description: Use this to schedule a social media post for later, on one channel or several. Costs no credits (X alone bills per call: hermoso_credits). FREE PLAN: up to 10 posts on 3 channels (a post counts once); paid plans are unlimited. Over it the post is refused and nothing is queued: relay the refusal as written, never retry or split the post. A MULTI-SLIDE creative goes in imageUrls[] as a CAROUSEL, in order, never just slide 1. Name the time in `at`, or pass `useQueue:true` for the brand’s next free POSTING SLOT (“just queue it”). Hermoso never guesses the account: Pinterest needs `boardId` (list_pinterest_boards), else refused; a LinkedIn COMPANY PAGE post needs `linkedinOrganizationId` (list_linkedin_pages), else it goes to the person’s own profile. Several Facebook Pages need `pageId` (list_meta_pages), for Facebook and for an Instagram that posts through a Page: none named is refused at scheduling with the Pages listed, so ask the user which. Resolve these FIRST; let the user pick. Posts GO LIVE PUBLICLY by default. Full rules: get_instructions({topic:'schedule_post'}).

accounts.description: WHICH accounts of a multi-account channel to post to, e.g. { "tiktok": ["@a", "@b"] } or { "tiktok": "all" } — one row per account at fire time, each with its own result. Omit for channels with one account (several and none named is refused by name).

actionType.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS — the call-to-action button. Every button except CALL needs `link` (CALL dials the number on the listing and takes none). Google IGNORES the button link on an OFFER post — put the destination in offer.redeemOnlineUrl. Omit and a post carrying a link gets LEARN_MORE.

aiGenerated.description: AI-CONTENT DISCLOSURE (Instagram / Facebook Reel is_ai_generated, TikTok is_aigc, YouTube containsSyntheticMedia, Pinterest ai_disclosures, Threads is_made_with_ai). OMIT IT and Hermoso decides from provenance: a Hermoso render is declared AI-generated, media that came through upload_file or from an external URL (the user’s own photos or footage) is NOT. Pass true or false only to override.

altText.description: ACCESSIBILITY — the screen-reader description of the image: what is IN the picture, never a repeat of the caption. One string covers every slide of a carousel; an ARRAY describes each slide in order (use it on a multi-slide post). More descriptions than pictures is refused. Write one whenever the post carries an image. CARRIED BY: X (max 1000 per media), Pinterest (max 500, Pin-level only: slide 1’s text is used and the result says the rest were not sent), LinkedIn company Pages (max 4086 per slide), Instagram images and image slides (max 1000), Facebook photos and albums, and Bluesky (REQUIRED on every image). Refused if the longest exceeds the tightest channel’s limit, never truncated. NOT CARRIED, not a refusal (the post publishes undescribed there and the result says which): TikTok, a Threads carousel, an Instagram Reel or video slide, a LinkedIn personal-profile post.

at.description: when to post: local wall clock, no offset (2026-10-30T10:00), read in `timezone` or the brand’s zone ON THAT DATE so a series survives a clock change; or UTC (…Z) / epoch ms. Future, at most 365 days out. Give this OR useQueue, never both.

atByChannel.description: per-channel times, e.g. {"x":"…T09:00"}; others use at/useQueue; each time is its own post

audience.description: FACEBOOK PAGE POST ONLY — limit who can see this organic post to people in these places and/or over this age (Facebook allows 13, 15, 18, 21 or 25). Not on Instagram, Threads or a Facebook Reel (a vertical clip becomes a Reel): those are refused. Region and city keys come from the Meta ads location search.

minAge.description: Facebook Page post audience: minimum age, one of 13, 15, 18, 21 or 25

audioId.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — put one of Instagram’s OWN licensed music tracks under the Reel: the `id` search_instagram_audio returns. Instagram mixes it in when the Reel is published; nothing is downloaded or re-rendered. REELS ONLY, and only on an Instagram account connected through Meta (a Facebook Page with a linked Instagram), which is Instagram’s own rule — the Instagram connector cannot take it and is refused by name.

audioName.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — the name of the Reel’s audio track, which is what viewers tap through to. REELS ONLY.

audioVolume.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — how loud that track plays, 0–100 (Instagram’s default 100). Needs audioId.

boardId.description: PINTEREST — REQUIRED whenever pinterest is a channel: the board the Pin goes on, from list_pinterest_boards. The user picks it; a Pin on the wrong board is a public mistake. Scheduling pinterest without one is refused immediately.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE this post belongs to, for THIS CALL ONLY (beats the connection’s pin): an id or exact name from list_brands. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is posted.

brandPartner.description: YOUTUBE: sponsoring brand channel (UC… or @handle). Carried to the upload when the post fires.

brandedContent.description: TIKTOK — the PAID-PARTNERSHIP disclosure (brand_content_toggle): true when the post promotes a THIRD-PARTY business. A compliance declaration, not a preference: set it whenever the post is sponsored. TikTok accepts it only on a public or friends-only post, so a private/SELF_ONLY or draft TikTok item with it is refused with the reason.

brandedContentSponsorIds.description: INSTAGRAM — the numeric Instagram USER IDS of the brands behind that label (at most 2, and ids rather than @handles). Naming sponsors IS asking for the label, so setting these with `paidPartnership:false` is refused instead of publishing brand credits with no disclosure.

buttons.description: TELEGRAM ONLY — URL buttons under the post, as post_to_telegram takes them; never on an album.

callToAction.description: FACEBOOK — a real call-to-action BUTTON on the Page post. The types that open a destination (SHOP_NOW, LEARN_MORE, SIGN_UP, BUY_NOW, DOWNLOAD, OPEN_LINK, WATCH_MORE, BOOK_TRAVEL) need somewhere to go: the post’s own `link`, or `callToActionLink`. CALL_NOW, MESSAGE_PAGE, LIKE_PAGE and GET_DIRECTIONS act on the Page itself and take none.

callToActionLink.description: FACEBOOK — where the button goes, when that is not the post’s own `link`.

captionTrack.description: YOUTUBE: a subtitle track (SRT or WebVTT) uploaded right after the video: url (a Hermoso-hosted file; upload_file returns one) OR text (the file body), plus language (BCP-47, required). If it fails the video is still posted and the result row carries the exact manage_youtube_caption call to retry the track.

captions.description: per-channel caption overrides, e.g. { "instagram": "…", "threads": "…" } — platforms want different lengths and hashtag conventions

categoryId.description: YOUTUBE: NUMERIC category id (28 Science & Technology, 27 Education, 24 Entertainment, 22 People & Blogs…; list_youtube_categories names them). Checked against YouTube’s assignable list when you schedule. Default 22.

channelOptions.description: rare per-channel extras: threadsChain[] / blueskyThread[] follow-ups threaded under it; linkedinPoll {question, options[], duration ONE_DAY|THREE_DAYS|SEVEN_DAYS|FOURTEEN_DAYS} a poll as the post; linkedinReshareOf repost this (link or urn); ytPlaylistId add to playlist; protectContent Telegram no forwarding/saving; telegramDocument file URL sent as the post; slackUsername / slackIconUrl / slackIconEmoji (:rocket:) the Slack app posts as that name and picture; sensitiveMedia [adult_content|graphic_violence|other] X media warning; geoRestriction {countries[] | excludeCountries[]} X media country limit (two-letter codes); textBackgroundPresetId Facebook text-only post on a coloured background (numeric preset id); tiktokLocationId + tiktokLocationName (search_tiktok_locations), tiktokMusicSoundId (songClipId from tiktok_ads_trending sounds), tiktokMusicVolume / tiktokOriginalSoundVolume 0-100, tiktokAdsOnly TikTok video as an ads-only post

channels.description: one or more channels to post to at that time

chatId.description: TELEGRAM — REQUIRED whenever telegram is a channel: which chat, group or channel the bot posts to, as a public channel’s @username or the numeric id (a group is negative; a supergroup or channel starts with -100). There is no default (the Bot API cannot list a bot’s chats), so telegram without one is refused up front. list_telegram_chats finds chats that messaged the bot in the last 24 hours.

collaborators.description: INSTAGRAM COLLAB — up to 3 Instagram usernames invited to CO-AUTHOR the post, so it appears on their profile too once they accept. Handles only ("hermosoai"; a leading @ is fine). Instagram must be one of the `channels`, else REFUSED now; other channels in the schedule publish without co-authors. THE INVITE IS SENT WHEN THE POST FIRES and stays PENDING until they accept: check instagram_collaborators before saying it is live on both profiles.

commercialContent.description: TIKTOK — the COMMERCIAL CONTENT DISCLOSURE: true when the post promotes a brand, product or service at all. Needs yourBrand and/or brandedContent with it (commercial without naming which is refused); setting either already implies it.

communityId.description: X — publish into an X COMMUNITY instead of the main timeline: the number in the community’s own URL (x.com/i/communities/<id>). The connected account must be a MEMBER of it.

countryCodes.description: THREADS ONLY — two-letter country codes to limit who can see the post. Omit to show it everywhere.

coverAtMs.description: THE VIDEO COVER on EVERY channel of this post, as ONE frame: milliseconds from the start (7000 = the frame at 7s), sent to Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn Page, Pinterest, Telegram and YouTube (X, Threads and Bluesky have no cover setting). A channel’s own field (thumbOffset, coverTimestampMs, coverUrl) wins there.

coverImageUrl.description: THE VIDEO COVER as a picture instead of a frame — a Hermoso-hosted image (upload_file). Every channel that takes a cover image gets it (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn Page, Pinterest, Telegram, YouTube); TikTok takes only a frame. Never together with coverAtMs.

coverTimestampMs.description: TIKTOK VIDEO ONLY — which frame TikTok uses as the cover, in milliseconds from the start. Omit and Hermoso uses the video’s best frame (platformCover:true leaves it to TikTok, which uses the first frame).

coverUrl.description: INSTAGRAM REEL COVER — a public image url Instagram fetches and uses as the cover in the Reels tab. REELS ONLY, and the alternative to `thumbOffset`: passing both is refused, since they are two answers to the same question. Run a local file through upload_file first.

crossreshareDarkMode.description: THREADS ONLY — render that Instagram Story in dark mode. Needs crossreshareToIg.

crossreshareToIg.description: THREADS ONLY — when this fires, ALSO share it to the linked Instagram account as a STORY. Refused on a Threads carousel. No confirmation exists that the Story was created, so the result says it was requested.

description.description: YOUTUBE: the video DESCRIPTION, max 5000 characters, carrying the links, the CTA and what YouTube search reads. Omit it and the caption is used.

disableComment.description: TIKTOK — turn comments off on this post.

disableDuet.description: TIKTOK VIDEO ONLY — block Duets. TikTok’s photo-post API has no Duets, so this is refused on a photo/slideshow item rather than silently dropped.

disableStitch.description: TIKTOK VIDEO ONLY — block Stitches. Same photo-post rule as disableDuet.

discordChannel.description: DISCORD bot: channel id or #name (default: the brand's)

discordReplyTo.description: DISCORD bot: reply to this message id

discordStartThread.description: DISCORD bot: open a thread under the post, this title

event.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS — required for an EVENT or OFFER post. `title` is the EVENT’s headline, not the post `title` (Pinterest/YouTube). Send the times whenever you know them: Google needs all four date/time parts for a valid interval.

title.description: event headline (required for an event or offer post)

excerpt.description: BLOG — the excerpt under the title

firstComment.description: FIRST COMMENT — posted on each new post as the same account right after it publishes, on Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn company Pages (LinkedIn needs its comments authorization, provider linkedin_community). Other channels publish without it and their result row says so. Up to 2,000 characters, refused rather than cut; never on a story. A failed comment never undoes the post.

fit.description: FIT A PHOTO TO THE CHANNEL’S SHAPE, ONLY WITH THE USER’S YES. Instagram takes images from 4:5 to 1.91:1 (Threads up to 10:1); a picture outside that is refused with a padded and a cropped PREVIEW and their sizes. Show the user both and ask; only then send the same request again with fit:"pad" (the whole picture kept, the new edges a blurred copy of it; true means pad) or fit:"crop" (the centre kept). Every out-of-range photo in the post is fitted the same way and the reply says what changed; the fitted copy is stored and the original file is untouched. Never pass it unasked: it changes the picture.

hook.description: Post_performance ranks hooks on it (a winner needs 5 posts sharing one); omitted, this post never votes.

ideaId.description: short id of the content-plan idea this post came from

imageUrl.description: a Hermoso render URL (a /generated path, or what upload_file returned), a data: URI, or a public https URL. Only Facebook/Instagram/Threads accept an arbitrary public URL; X, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest and Google Business REFUSE anything that is not a Hermoso render, so run an external file through upload_file first; a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

imageUrls.description: CAROUSEL — an ORDERED list of image URLs published as ONE swipeable post on every channel that supports it (Instagram 2–20, Threads 2–20, Facebook, LinkedIn company Pages 2–20, Pinterest 2–5, TikTok photo post up to 35). Use it for every multi-slide creative, never slide 1 alone; the order is kept. A channel here that cannot do carousels (X, YouTube, Google Business Profile) is REFUSED NOW with the reason, never downgraded later.

instagramCommentPrompt.description: INSTAGRAM — make the caption a COMMENT PROMPT that people answer in the comments. Same limits as instagramPoll, and never together with it.

instagramLocationId.description: INSTAGRAM — tag a place (called locationId on post_to_meta; locationId here is the Google Business listing). A non-numeric value is refused rather than sent.

instagramPoll.description: INSTAGRAM — attach a POLL: 2–4 answers of 1–25 characters; the caption IS the question, so a caption is required. Feed photos, carousels and Reels only (never a story), one caption add-on per post (not with instagramCommentPrompt), and only on an account connected through Meta (a Facebook Page with a linked Instagram). WRITE-ONCE: Instagram cannot change or remove it after publishing, so show the user the answers first.

instagramPollExtended.description: INSTAGRAM — give that poll Instagram’s extended voting duration instead of its default 3 days (Instagram’s changelog says it then stays open indefinitely). Only with instagramPoll.

linkAttachment.description: THREADS ONLY — a full http(s) URL rendered as a link card. This is the ONLY way a Threads post carries a destination, and Threads attaches it to TEXT-ONLY posts (a post with media cannot also carry a card).

linkDescription.description: FACEBOOK — override the DESCRIPTION of the link preview. Needs `link` and a verified domain (see linkName), else Meta refuses the post.

linkName.description: FACEBOOK — override the HEADLINE of the link preview (otherwise the destination’s Open Graph title, often empty on a bare landing page). Needs `link`. Facebook honours linkName, linkDescription and linkPicture only when the Page’s business has VERIFIED the link’s domain (Business Manager > Brand safety > Domains); otherwise Meta refuses the post (“Only owners of the URL…”), so leave them out unless the brand has verified it.

linkPicture.description: FACEBOOK — override the IMAGE of the link preview: a public http(s) url Facebook fetches. Needs `link` and a verified domain (see linkName), else Meta refuses the post.

linkedinOrganizationId.description: LINKEDIN — publish as a COMPANY PAGE instead of the connected personal profile. The organization id from list_linkedin_pages. Omit and it posts as the person: an unset id means the profile, never “probably the company”. A Page can also carry VIDEO, which a personal profile cannot.

locationId.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS PROFILE — which listing, e.g. 'locations/123' from list_business_locations. Needed when the account manages more than one storefront; it is never chosen for the user.

madeForKids.description: YOUTUBE: declare the video MADE FOR KIDS (COPPA). Default false.

madeWithAi.description: X — X’s AI-media label on this post. Opt-in: X treats it as the poster’s own claim about their media, so it is never set on the user’s behalf.

message.description: the caption/text used for every channel unless overridden in captions

notifySubscribers.description: YOUTUBE: notify subscribers when it goes live. Omit to follow the privacy (public notifies, unlisted/private do not); true announces anyway, false stays quiet even when public.

offer.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS — OFFER posts only: {couponCode, redeemOnlineUrl, termsConditions}. redeemOnlineUrl is where an offer actually sends people, since the button link is ignored on an Offer.

redeemOnlineUrl.description: link where the offer is redeemed online

termsConditions.description: terms text shown with the offer

optimizeCopy.description: RECOMMENDED when one caption goes to several channels: fit it to each channel’s rules at scheduling, wherever no per-channel caption was written (the fitted caption is stored, so what you scheduled is what publishes). The angle and every claim stay the author’s; a per-channel caption is left as written. Off by default, so nobody’s words are rewritten unasked.

pageId.description: FACEBOOK / INSTAGRAM / THREADS — which connected Facebook Page (and its linked Instagram) publishes, from list_meta_pages. With several Pages and no id, a Facebook post is refused WHEN YOU SCHEDULE IT, with the Pages listed by name and id: ask the user which and schedule again. Never a guessed Page.

paidPartnership.description: INSTAGRAM AND X — the PAID PARTNERSHIP label, a compliance declaration: set it when the post is sponsored, gifted or otherwise paid for. OPT-IN ONLY, never assume it on the user’s behalf. On Instagram, brandedContentSponsorIds names the brands behind it.

paidProductPlacement.description: YOUTUBE: paid product placement (shows the disclosure). Carried to the upload when the post fires.

parseMode.description: TELEGRAM ONLY — 'HTML' for Telegram's HTML tags; omit for plain text.

place.description: FACEBOOK — tag a location on the Page post.

placeName.description: the name the user saw for that place; a different business is refused

platformCover.description: VIDEO COVER. Omit it (the default) and Hermoso sets the video’s best frame — the same frame as its Library thumbnail — as the cover on every channel that allows one (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok direct posts, LinkedIn Pages, Pinterest, Telegram, YouTube) — and on X, Threads and Bluesky, which have none, a blank first frame is replaced on a copy sent there only. true = send no cover and let the platform pick (usually the first frame). A cover you pass yourself always wins.

poll.description: X — attach a poll. X makes a poll MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with media: an item carrying an image or video is refused, so schedule the poll as its own X-only post.

privacyLevel.description: TIKTOK privacy level, in TikTok’s vocabulary. TikTok requires the USER to choose it from the levels their account allows: call tiktok_creator_info, show them the options, pass back their pick; never a default or a guess (TikTok refuses it at init). Omitted, it falls back to `visibility` (private -> SELF_ONLY, otherwise PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE), which cannot express MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS or FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR. Must agree with the TikTok visibility; refused on a TikTok DRAFT.

quotePostId.description: THREADS ONLY — the id of the Threads post this one quotes.

recipe.description: the post's FORMAT id, e.g. "slideshow" or "imessage_chat" — post_performance groups by it, so reuse one id per format

replyControl.description: THREADS ONLY — who may reply. Omit for Threads' own default (everyone).

replySettings.description: X — who may reply. Omit for everyone, which is the right default for a brand post.

shareToFeed.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — true puts the Reel in the Feed grid as well as the Reels tab. REELS ONLY. Left unset it follows Instagram’s own default; Hermoso does not flip it either way on the user’s behalf.

slackChannel.description: SLACK app: channel id or #name (default: the brand's)

slackThreadTs.description: SLACK app: reply in this thread (parent ts)

slideText.description: PINTEREST CAROUSEL ONLY — per-slide title / description / link, aligned to slide order. Every other platform takes ONE caption for the whole carousel.

story.description: INSTAGRAM OR FACEBOOK PAGE STORY — publish as a 24-hour Story instead of a feed post. One image OR one video: Instagram has no carousel story, so a carousel is REFUSED BY NAME. No link stickers. An Instagram Story keeps its caption (shown under it in the app). No collaborators, product tags or trialReel: refused by name, nothing posted. FACEBOOK PAGE STORIES (target facebook): one image, or one vertical 9:16 video of 3–90 seconds, no caption (a message is refused by name); queue one with schedule_post, and the reply reads the story back from the Page.

subject.description: what the post is about (product, feature, offer or theme): post_performance’s second axis, so reuse the exact wording.

tags.description: YOUTUBE — up to 30 search tags (plain words, no #); [] = none, omitted = from the title.

targetAudience.description: LINKEDIN COMPANY PAGE POST ONLY — show the post only to Page followers matching these facets. LinkedIn requires the matching audience to be over 300 followers and refuses a smaller one. Personal-profile posts cannot be targeted.

organizations.description: urn:li:organization (school or company) or numeric id

staffCountRanges.description: LinkedIn company size bands, e.g. SIZE_11_TO_50

thread.description: X — publish a THREAD, one entry per post, each replying to the one before (at most 25). 280 characters per part without X Premium, up to 25,000 with it; nothing is truncated. It REPLACES the X caption: with a thread set, `message`/`captions.x` is not sent to X at all. A thread cannot carry a poll.

threadsGhostPost.description: THREADS ONLY — a GHOST post: text only, Threads archives it automatically after 24 hours (a flash offer, a 24h-only note). No other Threads option can ride it.

threadsGif.description: THREADS ONLY — a GIPHY GIF id (the id in a giphy.com/gifs/… link) attached to a TEXT Threads post. GIPHY is the only provider Threads takes.

threadsLongText.description: THREADS ONLY — LONG-FORM text, up to 10,000 characters, attached under a TEXT-only Threads post (Threads' text attachment). The way to publish more than Threads' 500-character post: keep a short lead in the message and put the full text here. Not with an image, video or carousel.

thumbOffset.description: INSTAGRAM REEL COVER, the other way — which frame becomes the cover, in MILLISECONDS from the start of the video. REELS ONLY. Use it instead of `coverUrl` when the right cover is already a frame of the clip.

thumbnailUrl.description: YOUTUBE: the custom thumbnail, a Hermoso-hosted image. Omit it and a frame of the video is used; "auto" keeps YouTube’s pick.

timezone.description: IANA zone (e.g. "Africa/Cairo") a wall-clock `at` or the queue is read in; overrides the brand’s saved zone for this one post. Without either, UTC.

title.description: PINTEREST / YOUTUBE — the headline, max 100 characters (Pinterest search and under the pin; YouTube requires one). Omitted, Hermoso derives one from that channel’s caption (first sentence, cut on a word, trailing hashtags dropped); set one whenever the caption does not open with a usable headline.

topicTag.description: THREADS ONLY — one topic tag for the post, without the leading #.

topicType.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS — the KIND of Post. STANDARD is the default; EVENT and OFFER both REQUIRE `event` (title + start date), and OFFER also takes `offer`.

trialReel.description: INSTAGRAM TRIAL REEL — show this Reel to NON-FOLLOWERS only at first, to test a hook on a cold audience; followers see it only if it graduates. MANUAL = graduated by hand in the Instagram app; SS_PERFORMANCE = Instagram graduates it if it performs. Needs Instagram’s follower threshold (about 1,000 followers): an ineligible account is refused by name and nothing is posted. REELS ONLY and INSTAGRAM ONLY: an image, a carousel or a Facebook/Threads channel is REFUSED BY NAME, never published as an ordinary post, so Instagram must be in `channels` and the item must carry a video. Omit it for a normal Reel.

useQueue.description: take the next free slot in a posting queue (“just queue it”): true = default queue, or a queue name (manage_post_queues). Not with `at`; refused by name when no slot is free.

userTags.description: INSTAGRAM USER TAGS — tag people (public accounts) on the post; each is notified. Usernames, or { username, x, y } with x/y from 0 to 1 = where the tag sits on the IMAGE (a tag without a position sits at the centre). A Reel tag takes no position; a story position is optional. Not on a carousel (refused by name).

videoUrl.description: a Hermoso render URL (a /generated path, or what upload_file returned), a data: URI, or a public https URL — required for youtube, and for tiktok unless you pass an imageUrl (TikTok takes a photo post too). Same origin rule as imageUrl: everything except Facebook/Instagram/Threads REFUSES a non-Hermoso URL, so pass external video through upload_file first; a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

videoVolume.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — how loud the video’s own sound plays under the track, 0–100 (Instagram’s default 100; 0 = the track alone). Needs audioId.

visibility.description: how it should be published — DEFAULT 'public' (live). Only pass something else if the user explicitly asked to stage/hide it. Not every channel supports every value; an impossible combination is refused when you schedule it, with the reason.

visibilityByChannel.description: override visibility for one channel, e.g. { "tiktok": "draft" } to go live everywhere but stage TikTok for review

webflowFields.description: WEBFLOW: required collection fields by slug, e.g. {author:"<item id>"}

whopExperienceId.description: WHOP — which forum or chat in the whop (exp_…, from list_whop_destinations). Omit it when the whop has only one; with several and none named the post is refused at fire time, never guessed.

whopMention.description: WHOP FORUM POSTS ONLY — notify every member (off by default).

whopPaywallCents.description: WHOP FORUM POSTS ONLY — a paywall in cents (500 = $5.00): readers pay to see the body; needs a title.

whopPaywallCurrency.description: WHOP — the paywall currency, a 3-letter code (default usd).

whopPinned.description: WHOP FORUM POSTS ONLY — pin it to the top of the forum.

whopPoll.description: WHOP FORUM POSTS ONLY — a poll: 2 to 10 options, in order.

whopVisibility.description: WHOP FORUM POSTS ONLY — who can see it; unset is the forum’s own default.

xArticle.description: X: publish the X item as a long-form X ARTICLE. title is its headline, the X text (message or captions.x) its markdown body, the image its cover. Refused now if the markdown has formatting X cannot hold. X allows about 5 Articles a day; one that fires into that cap fails with the reset time and can be retried.

headings.description: blocks (default) keeps real headings; text turns headings into bold lines

title.description: X Article headline; the post text becomes the article body in markdown

xQuotePostId.description: X — the numeric id of an X post this one QUOTES: the last part of its URL. NAMED xQuotePostId, NOT quotePostId, because `quotePostId` on this same schedule belongs to THREADS. Billed at X’s higher LINK rate.

yourBrand.description: TIKTOK — the OWN-BRAND disclosure (brand_organic_toggle): true when the post promotes the creator’s own business. TikTok asks for at least one of this and brandedContent once a post is commercial.

name: schedule_post
title: Schedule a post for later
